title: Vignette 2026-11-02: the browser budget is a memory warning, not an attachment rule

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: Owner, 2026-11-02, choosing on srs-web#234 what the web editor does when a repository has no attachment policy. Options put: (a) no limit, as the core; (b) keep a browser-memory budget but separate, as a whole-repository warning (srs-rust#1328 repo_size), not an attachment refusal; (c) do nothing, keep the 5 MB refusal. Claude Code's lean was (b): the 5 MB is about browser memory, not the repository's attachment rules. The owner: "b is good."

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-11-02; recorded verbatim. Follows vignette 5a11a114 (muSrs is a pretty important test case).
